# Bangla Agent

> Bangla Agent (banglaagent.com) is a Bangla-language resource on AI agents —
> what they are, how they work, and how Bangladeshi small and medium
> businesses can use them (WhatsApp order-taking, bKash/Nagad payment
> reminders, customer support automation, and similar use cases).

## Guides
Educational content explaining AI agent concepts in Bangla, aimed at
business owners and non-technical readers.

## Use Cases
Concrete, industry-specific examples of AI agents solving real problems for
Bangladeshi businesses (e-commerce, restaurants, retail, services).

## Tools
Profiles of AI agent platforms and tools relevant to the Bangladeshi market.
